label: FIXTURE RESULT: Stage 5 evaluation (recorded window, frozen bundle)

report.summary: Outbox publication stalled (~05:15:40 to ~05:17:40) while arrivals continued, building a backlog. 1011 of 1509 delivery attempts got 401 from the consumer; the cause of the auth failures is not shown.

findings.claim: Outbox publications fell to ~0 for about 12 buckets while arrivals continued at 22 per 10 s, so a backlog built and notifications were delayed.
findings.reason: Per-bucket publications are 1, 0, 0... against steady arrivals; pending rose from 2 to 224; arrivals minus publications is 111.

findings.claim: Most delivery attempts failed with auth errors (HTTP 401) from the consumer: 1011 of 1509. Only 498 succeeded.
findings.reason: Outcome counts show auth_error 1011 and no server or network errors; 401 latency is ~71 ms, so these are fast rejections, not timeouts.

findings.claim: The delay is in the delivery to the consumer, not in the transfers API, DB pool or locking.
findings.reason: Transfers return 201 with p99 0.25 s. The pool shows no timeouts or pending borrowers, and there is no DB blocking. Delivery attempts are fast 401s.

limitations: Only the earliest 100 delivery log rows are listed, covering 05:14:13 to 05:14:48, so the stall period's attempts are not individually visible.
The failed count is constant at 778 with an oldest-undelivered age of ~41,500 s, which predates the window. Whether the pre-existing backlog contributes is unclear.
next_checks: Inspect consumer auth logs and credentials/token expiry for the 401s, and check what changed around 05:15:40 and again at ~05:17:40.
Check outbox poller behaviour during the zero-publication period (backoff, retries, attempt limits).

alternatives.reason: The 401s fit this, but no tool shows the auth config on either side. The build is also marked dirty.
alternatives.hypothesis: Consumer credential or config mismatch (e.g. expired token) causes the 401s and stalls the outbox.

alternatives.reason: The pool had 0 timeouts and 0 pending, and no blocking was sampled.
alternatives.hypothesis: DB pool exhaustion or lock contention stalled publication.
